9756abcad3af696ede36.en: Newtalk News In 2023, a construction accident occurred at the "Jitai Dazhi" construction site in Zhongshan District, Taipei City. Due to the construction, nearby residents' houses collapsed and were damaged. It has been 3 years since the construction, and the homes of the affected families are still difficult to rebuild. The Taipei Municipal Government held a coordination meeting for the second time on September 30. Jitai Construction was absent again, allowing 21 of the affected families to gather outside the municipal government to protest. Wang Hongwei, the Kuomintang legislator, appeared at the scene and shouted slogans. However, when the affected household shouted "the weak cooperation of the city government", Wang Hongwei, who had originally shouted, immediately shut his mouth, which seemed quite embarrassing. Jitai Construction was again absent from the coordination meeting. The affected families gathered outside the Taipei City Government to hold a press conference and express their protest, waving signs and shouting in unison, "The builder has no fault". Wang Hongwei came to the scene and accompanied the slogan. Unexpectedly, when the affected families shouted out the next sentence "the city's weak cooperation", Wang Hongwei instantly shut his mouth and his expression was instantly embarrassed.

db39dbf02b615947ef90.en: Newtalk News Italian newspaper Corriere della Sera published a special article by veteran journalist Danilo Taino on the homepage today, warning that the status quo in the Taiwan Strait has been broken and that China is gradually destroying the status quo in an attempt to control Taiwan without launching a full-scale invasion. The article pointed out that the status quo in the Taiwan Strait has long been different from the past and has been gradually eroded by China, which is adopting a strategy of not resorting to force, or at least direct invasion, to try to control Taiwan. US President Trump recently met with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington. Most of the commentaries in the article concluded that Trump has not made concessions to China on the Taiwan issue. China wants to stop the United States from pushing forward with a $14 billion arms sale to Taiwan.

579371a0a6a0559c043f.en: Newtalk News US President Donald Trump held talks last week at the White House with visiting Chinese President Xi Jinping. Trump said today that the two discussed the release of Min Xin, an American Burmese researcher who was improperly detained by China, and Li Zhiying, the founder of the imprisoned Hong Kong One Media Group, and other issues at the meeting, "I hope it will be a fruitful discussion." The Sichuan Xuehui will appear at the White House on September 24, the second time the two have met this year. Ahead of the summit, the State Department in late August concluded that Min Zin, an American Myanmar researcher, had been “improperly detained” by China. Trump was asked by the media at an event at the White House this afternoon, did he discuss the release of political prisoners such as Min Xin and Li Zhiying at the Chuan Xue meeting last week? Trump responded, saying, “I think we've had some very, very important discussions.” “Hopefully it's a productive discussion,” he says.
